text: {"lessons":["My account has generally grown while I made few trades, so I should avoid unnecessary activity and focus on deliberate decisions.","Selling Stock D at a loss reminded me not to let my purchase price dictate whether I keep or sell an investment; I should assess its prospects and the risk it adds to my account.","In retirement, my savings need to support my living expenses, so I should favor diversification and a steady level of risk over large bets or attempts to chase short-term gains."]}
